draft_en.subject: Industrial switches and converters under the Fiber Optic Link label - an ODM source that leaves your margin intact
draft_en.body:
Hi Cesar,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "Managed PoE Switches" on 24 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the industrial switches and media converters sold under the Fiber Optic Link label, an ODM source in your housing from small lots, -40 to 75 C, FCC/CE/RoHS: DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2 managed, Marvell-based - model STI-288GPM - $85.5 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); Gigabit media converter, 1 x RJ45 + 1 x SFP slot - STI-110GE - $26.5; PoE version - STI-111GP - $30.1. ONUs and GPON gear we do not carry.

One question: which model do your dealers reorder most - the managed switch or the converter?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
